title: Aromatic Croatian Potatoes Gratin
description: A nutty, cheese‑pull gratin that highlights baby new potatoes with a blend of Croatian herbs and anti‑inflammatory ingredients. It broils to a golden crisp and warms the soul.

ingredients.name: walnuts, toasted and chopped
ingredients.notes: toasted in oven at 350F for 10 minutes until fragrant

instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
Wash baby new potatoes and cut them in half if large.
Toss potatoes with olive oil, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, chopped parsley, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Spread the potato mixture in the prepared dish and roast for 25 minutes until golden brown.
While potatoes roast, combine toasted walnuts, grated cheese and heavy cream in a small bowl.
After roasting, remove the dish and evenly spread the walnut‑cheese mixture over the potatoes.
Broil the gratin for 5 minutes until the top is bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then serve warm.
